diagnostic: S1 GREEN through the real driving port: ui-bare-pages 39/39 scenarios, 227/227 steps, including all 16 @needs-browser card and shortcut readings and the 14 autocomplete rows. Keep-green verified: keyboard 9/9, kb 38/38, us-b04 4/4, canzan-theme-system 30/30, cargo test -p foundry-app, cargo xtask check-arch (asset-reference, asset-hash, colour-token, pre-paint-script layers), cargo xtask smoke :: all gates green. Whole oracle run once (FOUNDRY_ACCEPTANCE_TAGS=all): 2358 scenarios, 2355 passed. Prefactor committed alone and green first (586939d): L2 extract, partials/keyboard_shortcut_rows.html becomes the one owner of the rows and the selection instruction and shortcut_entries() the one row builder, because the page arm needs the rows WITHOUT the dialog container; behaviour preserved, same table, same order, same bare fragment. Behaviour commit 7d4de8a. help_variant is total over every header map and answers Fragment for every value it does not recognise, so the safe arm is the default; Vary: Sec-Fetch-Dest is set once beside that decision and carried by BOTH arms. The issue page fills title, description, status_slug and status_chip from the one existing issue_edit_view read over the project and number already resolved; Ok(None) between the two reads refuses with the shipped uniform not-found page rather than drawing a blank issue (B1 arm, still unobserved as designed). render_state_chip widened to pub(crate), output bytes unchanged. Stylesheet renamed foundry.2f9e0cb1.css -> foundry.e770ce20.css with its three readers in the same commit. DESIGN GAP, retained and not blocking: the design's shipped-promise list omitted NFR-4/ODD-8, the no-JS full-page read of keyboard-shortcut-bindings.feature:115, which finds the list by .keyboard-help. The first implementation of the page arm regressed it. Repaired in production, not in the lane: keyboard_help_page.html carries class=keyboard-help and NO dialog role, so the no-JS operator finds the list and a navigated page is still not announced as a dismissable dialog. The architect should add that promise to the preserved list. INDETERMINATE, not attributable to this batch: us-01-install.feature's two docker compose up -d --wait scenarios fail (exit 101) in the shared local-dev VM, reproducibly in the all run and in the docker-compose lane. The image BUILDS from this tree (the two image/compose-file inspection scenarios of that same feature pass), the binary compiles, and every in-process HTTP and browser lane is green, so the failure is at container start/health in a VM that is concurrently hosting three other projects' Postgres containers (canzan-lift-postgres on 15432, foundry-examine-pg, one unnamed on 34161). No baseline run was taken, so this is could-not-verify, not green and not a known regression; owner is the platform/infrastructure side of us-01, not this slice's design or oracle. A us-01 selection by FOUNDRY_ACCEPTANCE_TAGS=us-01 is a false signal and was discarded: tests/acceptance.rs builds the shared image only for mode docker-compose or all, so that selection reports a missing image rather than a defect. typesafe: unavailable - TYPESAFE_API_KEY is not set in this environment, so no Jev call was made; the open choices (where the no-JS .keyboard-help promise should be honoured, and whether the compose failures are mine) were settled against repository evidence - the runner's own lane gate and the differing failure sets between two runs of one tree.
